intent_snapshot.goal: Enable explicit, content-bound amendment of an existing GitHub Initiative's complete pending frontier while preserving historical Child Issues and native ownership, as specified in docs/specs/initiative-amendment.md; retain strict default publication behavior and do not execute or publish the paused Loop plan.

acceptance.assertion: The public publication API and CLI implement the complete amendment invariant in docs/specs/initiative-amendment.spec.md: approved existing open Parent/pending Child updates and new Children converge with exact pending dependencies; historical identity, bytes, terminal evidence and relations are preserved and excluded from execution. Every write revalidates its target immediately beforehand (bound identity, open state, ownership, baseline-or-approved-final content), so concurrent user edits between reads and writes fail closed with zero or bounded mutations. Pending-binding semantics are three-state: bound (issue_number), unbound amendment child (undefined, guarded creation with post-creation closure verification), and non-amendment path (null). Unbound new Children that are uniquely owned, open and exactly approved-final are accepted as resumable creations, and approved-final bound Children that lost their Sub-issue attachment are re-attached to the Parent before dependency convergence, making every amendment outcome retryable as a whole batch with its original input. Input tasks and amendment tasks match as exact sets before topology validation. Slice identities are unique across historical and pending Children, verified before writes and re-verified in post-publication historical verification. Bound content, closed membership, task-set mismatch and slice collisions fail closed before or after any write. Terminal-suffix leniency in final verification is restricted to pending amendment Child issues: the Parent and the strict non-amendment path use byte-exact comparison, and reserved parser sentinel terminal event ids ("multiple", "malformed") are rejected at the validation boundary before any remote read or write.

docs/agents/issue-tracker.md and plugins/immune-brain/dist/imm-planner.md document the amendment contract, input schema, baseline binding, convergence semantics, fail-closed outcomes and retry action for unbound resumable creations; published outputs mirror committed spec text.
Amendment types, validation, and serialization preserve the strict default publication behavior and all existing tracker guarantees; bun run typecheck passes.

attestations.summary: Verified the immutable revision, single parent, tree, changed-path object identities and manifest digest; reviewed all five changed paths and embedded passing Kernel QA outcomes, with no blocking correctness or regression findings.

findings.summary: plugins/immune-brain/runtime/github_issue_tracker.ts:1422 and :889: Bound pending Children are checked for attachment but never compared against binding.issue_number; title/body validation occurs only when their operation runs, after the Parent and potentially earlier Children have been edited. A wrong bound Issue number is ignored, and known pending-content drift does not produce the documented zero-write rejection. Validate every pending identity, state and original-or-approved-final content before any mutation, then revalidate the affected binding before its write; add wrong-number and later-Child drift regressions.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/github_issue_tracker.ts:1576: The initial Parent check accepts only the original binding, so once the Parent edit succeeds, resubmitting the identical approved batch fails as baseline drift, including after a partial failure or lost response. The repeat test at tests/plugin-package-runtime.test.ts:1547 rebuilds bindings from mutated Issues and therefore misses this failure. Accept the same bound identity with either original content or a deterministically rendered approved final Parent, and test retries using the unchanged original input.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/github_issue_tracker.ts:1254: Dependency validation now runs while taskIds is still being populated. A valid default batch listing a dependent before its prerequisite is incorrectly rejected; in amendment mode that prerequisite is instead seeded as already done through foreign_dependers, allowing incorrect parallel groups and some cycles to escape preflight. Collect all pending IDs first, validate membership in a separate pass, and seed the topological sort only with completed historical prerequisites; cover reverse-ordered batches and amendment cycles.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/github_issue_tracker.ts:889: Exact dependency convergence is invoked only when the Child title/body differs. When content is already final but obsolete native blockers remain, including after an edit succeeded and dependency removal failed, execution falls through to confirmBlockedBy, which rejects the extra edges instead of removing them. Route every validated amendment pending Child through exact dependency convergence regardless of whether its prose needs editing, and test relation-only repair and interrupted-removal retry.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/github_issue_tracker.ts:1494: convergePendingDependencies removes edges and calls attachBlockedBy using an earlier snapshot without revalidating Child state, Parent/Slice ownership or native attachment before each mutation. updatePendingChild also returns before the ordinary Child ownership checks. A Child detached or closed after initial topology validation can still have its brief and dependencies changed, with failure reported only later. Revalidate affected ownership and open state before each edit/edge mutation and stop immediately on observed drift; add injected detach/close tests.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/github_issue_tracker.ts:787 and :1627: Historical Slice preservation depends on a narrow single-line checklist regex, although ownership validation accepts any exactly-once Slice marker. A valid user-reformatted historical entry is silently removed when the Parent is rewritten. Final validation also derives expected historical lines from the final remote body itself, so concurrent edits or deletion of those lines can be accepted. Derive and validate the historical Slice representation from the approved baseline before writing, fail closed on unsupported representations, and compare final content against that fixed expectation.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/github_issue_tracker.ts:1661: Historical final verification compares title/body/open-or-closed state and attachment but never snapshots or compares historical blocked_by relations or closure reason. Concurrent changes to historical dependency edges or a non-prerequisite Child's terminal reason can therefore yield a successful execution result despite the historical-preservation invariant. Capture those observations during preflight and compare them before reporting convergence; add historical-edge and closure-reason drift tests.

新增 Child 被阻断：所有 pending Slice 必须已在 Parent baseline、所有 pending Child 必须已可观察且已附属，未绑定新 Task 永远无法进入创建路径，创建成功但 attachment 失败的整批重试也被拒绝。仅对既有绑定要求 baseline Slice 和现存身份；允许未绑定新 Child 缺失，并允许精确最终内容的未附属 Child 恢复 attachment。补充 public API/CLI 新增及部分失败重试测试。
DELETE /dependencies/blocked_by 在 body 传 issue_id，但 GitHub 删除依赖接口是 DELETE /dependencies/blocked_by/{issue_id} 路径参数；真实删除会失败。改为带 blocker database ID 的资源路径，并修正 FakeGh 使其拒绝错误 endpoint。
删除每条依赖前没有重新验证 Child 的 open 状态、绑定内容及 Parent/Slice/native attachment，后续 attachBlockedBy 也只查询依赖列表；Child 在编辑后被关闭或移到其他 Parent 时仍继续修改全部依赖。在每个受影响写入前刷新并验证绑定及所有权，drift 后停止后续 mutation，并增加 drift 测试。

identity/state drift 与 content drift 合并，最终 title/body 匹配会跳过整个错误：binding.issue_number 错误仍可成功、已关闭 Parent 仍触发 pending 写入。始终单独强制 issue_number 和 open state 匹配，仅 title/body 放宽为 baseline 或 exact-final，并增加身份错误/Parent 已关闭的零写入测试。

历史最终验证仅检查 title/body/state 和 attachment，未读取或比较历史 Child 的 blocked_by，也不保留 state_reason；历史依赖在执行期间改变或非 prerequisite 历史从 completed 改为 not_planned 仍返回成功。记录并比较历史依赖集合及 terminal state_reason，变化时停止成功交付，补充漂移测试。
Review returned this acceptance boundary twice; a durable replan is required.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/github_issue_tracker.ts:895 checks the initial snapshot again rather than refreshing before the Parent edit at line 910. A user edit or closure during the intervening topology/dependency reads is therefore overwritten; final observation can report success after losing that edit. Re-read and validate the bound Parent identity, open state and baseline/final content immediately before writing, and add a transport-hook regression that edits the Parent during preflight.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/github_issue_tracker.ts:1648 validates ownership once before the entire DELETE loop, and line 1662 similarly validates once before attachBlockedBy performs multiple additions. If the Child closes or loses ownership after the first mutation, subsequent edges are still changed. The regression at tests/plugin-package-runtime.test.ts:1669 reproduces closure after the first DELETE but only checks the status, allowing the second DELETE. Revalidate identity, content and ownership before every edge mutation and assert that no subsequent mutation occurs after drift.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/github_issue_tracker.ts:1546 rejects every observable unbound new Child, including one created by the same approved batch before an attachment failure or later interruption. Consequently even a successfully completed amendment containing new Children cannot be retried with its original input. Accept uniquely owned, open Children carrying exact approved-final content as resumable creations and converge their attachment/dependencies; test identical-input retry after creation, failed attachment and successful completion.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/github_issue_tracker.ts:870 discards any baseline Slice line whose ID appears in pending work, without checking collisions with historical Children. A new Task using a historical Child's slice_id replaces the historical entry with pending prose while both Children can pass ownership checks and the batch can succeed. Validate Slice identity uniqueness across historical and pending Children before rendering or writing; reject reuse of historical Slice IDs and add a zero-mutation regression.
Review returned this acceptance boundary twice; a durable replan is required.

TaskRecord state file lacks a persisted ReviewRevisionIdentity and the review prompt must supply it; the reviewer reconstructed the immutable revision from refs/immune-brain/reviews (review_commit 0b94c43042ed996ea627a77df29045fc1ff2823c, single parent 6477834, tree 270919b1) and verified the digest against the Kernel reservation evidence. Source review completed against that immutable revision; advisory only: persist or embed the ReviewRevisionIdentity in the dispatch prompt to remove reconstruction ambiguity.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/github_issue_tracker.ts:870 仅凭 Parent Slice 的 '- [x]' 判断历史身份，但 markTerminal 不会勾选 Parent，因此新 pending Child 可以复用正常已完成历史 Child 的 Slice：历史行被替换，两个 Child 共用同一 Slice，最终仍可返回成功。应从 historical bindings 对应 Child 的 slice-id 建立唯一性集合，在写入前及最终检查中验证跨 historical/pending 的唯一性，并添加此回归测试。

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/github_issue_tracker.ts:941、1020 新建及恢复的 unbound Child 未经过 amendment 写前保护：传入 undefined 会触发 pendingBinding=null 默认值，随后 attachment 和 attachBlockedBy 沿用无重新验证的旧路径。若创建后读取已观察到 Child 被关闭，代码仍会挂接并添加全部依赖，直到批次末尾才拒绝。应显式保留 amendment 模式，并在每次创建、挂接和依赖写入前验证相应目标的身份、open 状态、ownership 和批准内容；添加创建后关闭及两次边写入之间漂移的测试。

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/github_issue_tracker.ts:1775 只检查实际执行 Task 属于 pending/historical 的并集，没有要求 input.tasks 与 amendment.tasks 精确对应。将已有 pending Child 留在 amendment.tasks bindings 中却从 input.tasks 删除，会通过拓扑预检并修改 Parent，随后才因最终成员数不符失败；Parent 还可能保留这个未执行 Child 的旧 Slice。应在任何远端写入前验证两个 pending Task ID 集合完全相等且与 historical 不相交，并测试遗漏已有 pending projection 时零写入。

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/github_issue_tracker.ts:1595 注释允许 bound Child 在 approved-final 状态下缺少挂接并通过重试恢复，但紧接着 confirmTerminalOwnership 无条件要求已挂接，且 updatePendingChild 本身没有补挂接路径。因此部分执行期间 Child 被解除挂接后，原始批次永远不能重试收敛。应对精确 approved-final 的 bound Child 验证身份及无外部 Parent 后安全补挂接，并增加冻结原始输入、部分失败、同输入恢复的测试。
Review returned this acceptance boundary twice; a durable replan is required.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/github_issue_tracker.ts:1685: approved-final Child reattachment does not revalidate its target immediately before mutation. approvedNow uses the earlier snapshot; confirmAttachment reads only Sub-issue numbers, and attachSubIssue immediately performs the POST. A Child edited or closed during the intervening ownership/relation reads is therefore attached using stale approval evidence. Subsequent verification cannot undo that unauthorized relation write. Re-read and validate the exact Child identity, open state, approved-final bytes, and eligible Parent immediately before attachment; add a regression that changes or closes the detached Child during the preceding relation read and asserts no attachment mutation.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/github_issue_tracker.ts:1696: the immediate pre-edit snapshot validates Child identity, state and bytes, but never rechecks native Parent attachment or Parent ownership. A bound baseline Child detached or moved after the earlier topology check still receives the content rewrite at line 1707 because detachment leaves its body unchanged. Dependency/final verification detects the loss only after the write. Revalidate the Child's native attachment and exact Parent/Slice ownership before editing, and add a regression that detaches the Child after topology validation but before the pre-edit snapshot, asserting that its content remains untouched.
Review returned this acceptance boundary twice; a durable replan is required.

R1 resolved: updatePendingChild's approvedNow re-attach path now re-reads and revalidates the Child (identity, open state, approved-final bytes, Parent/Slice ownership) immediately before the attachment mutation via revalidatePendingChildBeforeWrite with the attachment check deferred to the post-attach confirm. Verified by tests/plugin-package-runtime.test.ts (47/47) and full suite 1264/1264.

R2 resolved: updatePendingChild's content-edit path now routes through revalidatePendingChildBeforeWrite, which re-reads the Child immediately before the edit and revalidates bound issue_number identity, open state, baseline-or-approved-final bytes, native Parent attachment, and exact Parent/Slice ownership, so a detached or moved Child never receives a content rewrite. Verified by tests/plugin-package-runtime.test.ts (47/47) and full suite 1264/1264.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/github_issue_tracker.ts:988: Unbound Child creation lacks amendment pre-write revalidation. upsertTask accepts a closed Parent at lines 953-963 and performs blocker relation reads after its last identity snapshot; a Parent closed before this snapshot, or a competing Child created during those reads, still causes issue create. Post-creation checks detect the problem only after an avoidable mutation. Immediately before creation, revalidate the bound Parent identity, open state and approved content, and recheck Task absence or exact resumable ownership; add race tests asserting no creation on observed drift.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/github_issue_tracker.ts:1671: Approved pending terminal suffixes cannot converge. approvedAmendmentContent at lines 847-854 always stores a suffix-free childBody, while updatePendingChild preserves an existing suffix and then rejects that body against approvedFinal. An open Child left by a failed terminal close therefore passes baseline preflight, allows the Parent update, and fails every original-input retry. Derive approved-final bytes including the validated baseline terminal suffix, and use those same bytes in final publication validation at line 1984; cover original-input retries with an open terminal-marked Child.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/github_issue_tracker.ts:825: Missing or duplicate historical Slice markers throw from approvedAmendmentContent, which is called outside runGithubInitiativePublication's validation try/catch at line 1897. These caller-controlled binding errors reject the public API promise rather than returning a structured fail-closed publication result; the CLI instead emits invalid_tracker_command without the publication JSON. Validate these binding constraints inside the guarded preflight or return a structured failure, with API and CLI regressions for both malformed and duplicate historical Slice identities.

docs/agents/issue-tracker.md:69 and plugins/immune-brain/dist/imm-planner.md:222 do not document the required unbound resumable-creation recovery contract. Neither explains that an existing uniquely owned, open, exact approved-final new Child may retain an omitted binding and resume through the original complete batch; the Planner text instead says each Child is bound. Document the distinction between existing bound and new unbound Children, exact resumability conditions, approved-final reattachment, and retrying the unchanged complete input without rebinding partial creations.
Review returned this acceptance boundary twice; a durable replan is required.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/github_issue_tracker.ts:1889：terminal suffix 的保留与写前验证不一致。updatePendingChild:1751 写入带 suffix 的 finalBody，但 dependency 写前只接受不带 suffix 的 approvedFinal.body；只要需要增删依赖便永久失败。原始输入重试还会在 :1663 因 stripTerminalSuffix 返回 trimEnd 后的正文、而批准正文保留末尾换行而失败。应统一验证并保留合法 suffix 的内容比较，覆盖冻结原始输入、正文更新后依赖失败及再次重试；tests/plugin-package-runtime.test.ts:1603 当前测试重新绑定远端正文且没有依赖变化，未覆盖该失败路径。

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/github_issue_tracker.ts:1632：historical Child 只经过 classifyObservedChildren 和 confirmTerminalOwnership，未经过 taskLookup/ownedTaskLookup 的 repository、protocol 和全仓 Task 唯一性验证；最终 :2099 也只按绑定编号与正文查找。因此 historical Child 缺失 repo-id/protocol，或另一 Initiative 存在重复 task-id，仍可通过并返回 execution（该历史项不被用作 blocker 时）。应在任何写入前及最终 historical 验证中复用完整 ownership lookup，并要求解析结果与绑定 Issue 一致，增加对应拒绝测试。

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/github_issue_tracker.ts:995：unbound Child 创建前虽然重新获取 snapshot，却只检查 Task 是否出现，没有验证该新 snapshot 中 Parent 的绑定身份、open 状态、批准内容和 Slice。Parent 在之前读取后已关闭或被编辑时，代码仍在 :1009 创建 Issue，之后才由 attachment guard 拖绝，留下本可避免的远端写入。应在创建前使用这次 snapshot 验证 Parent 的绑定身份、open 状态及批准内容/Slice；增加在 pre-create reread 前关闭或编辑 Parent、断言不发出 create 的测试。
Review returned this acceptance boundary twice; a durable replan is required.

updatePendingChild computes finalBody from the earlier Child snapshot, but its immediate pre-write validation accepts any approved-final body with a valid terminal suffix. If another publisher applies the approved content and a terminal projection appends evidence before this re-read, validation succeeds and the subsequent edit overwrites that newly observed suffix with the stale finalBody, deleting or replacing terminal evidence. Return the validated Child observation and preserve its exact suffix when deciding whether and what to write, or fail closed when the suffix changed. Add a race test that injects approved-final content plus a terminal suffix before the content-write revalidation and verifies that the suffix is never overwritten.

revalidatePendingChildBeforeWrite finds the target by Issue number and checks its local task marker, but never performs the repository-wide taskLookup/ownedTaskLookup used elsewhere to establish unique ownership. A duplicate Task identity introduced after upsertTask's snapshot is therefore visible in the immediate pre-write snapshot yet ignored; content, attachment, or multiple dependency writes can proceed before the later ownedTaskLookup finally rejects the ambiguity. Resolve the task through ownedTaskLookup in every pre-write revalidation and require the exact bound Issue number, Initiative, and Slice. Add a test introducing a duplicate Task Issue between the initial lookup and a pre-write snapshot and assert that no subsequent mutation occurs.
Review returned this acceptance boundary twice; a durable replan is required.

[P1] plugins/immune-brain/runtime/github_issue_tracker.ts:1873,1884,1795,1819: All four pre-write guards test `op in revalidated`, but GithubTrackerResult exposes `operation` and `contract`, never `op` (lines 26-34,292-299). Consequently a detected concurrent close, ownership conflict, content drift or transport failure is ignored before attachment/dependency mutations; the content-update path instead casts the failure as GithubIssue and throws on undefined.body.matchAll. Use the actual `contract` discriminator at every caller and narrow the return union without casts. Add tests injecting drift immediately before each write, asserting zero subsequent mutations and a structured failure; the existing dependency-close test checks only the eventual status and misses continued writes.

[P1] plugins/immune-brain/runtime/github_issue_tracker.ts:1644: Pending topology preflight never performs repository-wide taskLookup/ownedTaskLookup. classifyObservedChildren filters by the current Initiative, while confirmTerminalOwnership validates only parent/slice attachment. A pending Child with a missing repo/protocol marker, or a duplicate task-id in another Initiative, therefore passes this preflight and permits the Parent rewrite before upsertTask finally rejects it. This violates the explicit before-any-write ownership rejection contract, independently of the pre-write guard defect. Resolve every existing bound or resumable pending task through repository-wide ownership lookup during topology validation, require the exact issue number and requested Initiative/Slice, and add zero-mutation regressions for malformed pending ownership and cross-Initiative duplicates.
Review returned this acceptance boundary twice; a durable replan is required.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/github_issue_tracker.ts:834-837 uses slice.id to query amendment.tasks, but that Map is keyed by task_id (1539-1549). This misclassifies bound versus new Slices. For example, an existing bound Task with task_id='amend-live', slice_id='live', plus a new unbound Task with slice_id='amend-live', has unique valid Slice identities, yet publication rejects it because baselineHistoricalSlices incorrectly requires the new Slice to already exist in the Parent baseline. Conversely, ordinary bound Tasks whose task_id differs from slice_id bypass the intended bound-Slice baseline check. Derive boundSliceIds from prepared.order, looking up each operation.task_id and collecting operation.slice_id. Add coverage where Task IDs and Slice IDs differ, including a new Slice matching another Task's ID.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/github_issue_tracker.ts:1680-1681 and 1066-1070 do not consistently accept an original bound baseline with a_terminal suffix appended remotely. markTerminal constructs the suffixed body from issue.body.trimEnd() (1207), so stripTerminalSuffix returns baseline bytes without the trailing newline generated by childBody; comparison against the original binding.body therefore fails during topology validation whenever the requested amendment changes the brief. Even if topology equality is repaired, upsertTask strips the binding instead of the observed remote body and rejects the same state. This contradicts the documented suffix-free-baseline retry contract and prevents convergence with the original approved input. Use the existing validated suffix-aware equality helper consistently for baseline comparisons in both places, and add a regression retaining the original binding while a failed terminal close appends a suffix to the baseline body before the changed amendment runs.
Review returned this acceptance boundary twice; a durable replan is required.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/github_issue_tracker.ts:879-885: baselineHistoricalSlices uses a greedy whole-line regex and skips the entire matched line when its last Slice marker belongs to pending work. A baseline Parent containing one historical marker followed by one pending marker on the same line passes the existing exactly-once ownership checks, but amendment generation silently drops the historical marker. The Parent is then rewritten without it. Final historical verification at lines 2143-2168 checks Child identity/content, attachment and relations, but not the historical marker in the regenerated Parent, so a batch with no pending dependency on that historical Child can report successful execution while breaking its terminal ownership. Smallest fix: reject mixed or multiple Slice markers on a baseline line before writing, and validate that the generated Parent contains each declared historical Slice marker exactly once. Add a regression covering a historical marker followed by a pending marker on the same line.
